title: feat(spec)!: retire the view form's visibleOn and the page component's visibility as keys; their ADR-0089 renames leave the load path (F4 of #23543)
body:
Part of #23543
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

This PR lands family **F4** of ruling `6182001882` (item 4) only. F5-http stays on #23543 as its own PR, so #23543 remains open.

## What

Ruling F4 A: "`visibleOn` (view) and `visibility` (page component) retire as keys: `retiredKey` tombstones naming `visibleWhen` with the full `spec-property-retirement` kit (ADR-0087 markers, baselines, forms, docs, pins); both entries retire in the same change; the three record / strict-exit suites re-point."

- **Three declared positions, measured on `main` at `f606ba2e25`** (`authorable-surface/ui.json`): `ui/FormField:visibleOn`, `ui/FormSection:visibleOn`, `ui/PageComponent:visibility`. There are no others. The inline form field and the page-block section entry in `component.zod.ts` never declared `visibleOn`; they already refuse it by name. Each of the three is now a `retiredKey()` tombstone whose prescription names `visibleWhen`, for example: "`page.components[].visibility` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0089 D2) — … Use `visibleWhen`. Rename the key; the value (a CEL predicate) is unchanged. Where a component writes both, `visibleWhen` is the one that was in effect: delete `visibility`." There is no `os migrate meta` sentence, on purpose. Both conversions are protocol 15, below `MIGRATION_SUPPORT_FLOOR`, so the tool lists no edit for them. This is the F5-jsx precedent, and the removal-version pin's `--from` rule (toMajor − 1 = 14) leaves no legal sentence anyway.
- **The fold is gone.** The three `.transform(normalizeVisibleWhen)` pipes existed only to fold the old keys, so they are removed and all three shapes are plain closed objects. `FormField` still omits `'visibleOn'` from its parsed type, so a reader of parsed output that reaches for the key still fails `tsc`.
- **The two D2 entries** `view-visibleOn-to-visibleWhen` and `page-component-visibility-to-visibleWhen` get `retiredFromLoadPath: true` and `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, the stamp F1/F5-jsx/F3/F2 used and still the newest stable (`18.0.0-next.2` label). Their "recorded verdict at 18" paragraphs are rewritten as retirement records. Fixtures are unchanged: every `includeRetired` seam still replays them.
- **ADR-0087 registration:** three `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entry files, and one D3 entry `ui-visibility-alias-keys-retired` with no `conversionIds` (below the floor, the F5-jsx shape). There is no `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment, because no step-18 conversion exists. The changeset marker is `registered ui-visibility-alias-keys-retired`.
- **Pins:** the verdict-list pin in `conversions.test.ts` now keeps one entry, `flow-node-http-callout-rename`, and lists the two among the retired. `view-spelling-walk.test.ts` gains a case stating that the stored seam still replays the retired rename. The removal-version `JOIN` gains rows for both ids (three tombstones). There is a new repo-project pin, `ui/visibility-alias-keys-retirement.test.ts`, covering:
  - the type channel (`@ts-expect-error` at each authoring type);
  - the walked shape;
  - `defineStack` refusals with code + status;
  - load-path retirement;
  - stored view/page rows loading renamed;
  - the ledger rows;
  - a tree-scoped absence walk over the radius `@objectstack/spec#test` already declares.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 「何时显示」这个条件只保留一个写法 `visibleWhen`。表单视图里的旧写法 `visibleOn` 和页面组件里的旧写法 `visibility` 不再被悄悄转换，作者写了会当场报错，并告诉他改成 `visibleWhen`。
- **为什么改:** 这是你 F4 A 的裁决。旧写法已经声明为弃用好几个版本，但解析时仍被默默折叠，等于同一件事有三种拼法；本仓示例和应用里 0 处在写旧拼法。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 第三方如果还写旧键，升级后会看到明确报错，改一个键名即可；数据库里存着旧键的视图和页面照常加载（读取时自动改名）。objectui 有读旧键的地方和两三个测试会在它下次升级 spec 时需要跟改，由席位立 objectui 跟进单。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。本 PR 带出一处生成文件 `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`（一行类型从 `any[]` 变成 `object[]`），所以按受管面走人合。
- **席位意见:** 席位复核通过(`domain:spec` 席位 1),契约复核第二轮 PASS(`6212287597`,在当前 head `860f4a18be` 上)。第一轮复核 FAIL 只有一处问题:说明文字声称「每个入口都先解析」,其实 `os lint` 不解析,已按复核意见只改文字并补一条测试。三处旧键都改成报错并提示 `visibleWhen`,两条旧转换不再在加载时运行,但库里存着的旧行读取时仍会自动改名(复核按代码核实)。CI 全绿。建议批准合并;这是 Tier H(带出 `skills/**` 的生成文件),席位不会自己翻 ready 或入队。
- **你要做的:** 这是 Tier H,需要你亲手批准或合并。合并后席位会:开 objectui 跟进单(渲染器读旧键的地方和三个会在下次 spec 升级时变红的测试);开一张卡退役已无调用方的 `normalizeVisibleWhen` / `VISIBILITY_ALIAS_KEYS` 导出;读合入后第一轮 Spec Shape Gate,若变红就按登记表流程登记。

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

1. **Every declared position:** three, listed above.
2. **The parse-time fold:** removed (above). On `derivedKeys`, keeping `'visibleOn'` would NOT give two messages: the tombstone aborts the section parse, so the group-reference refinement never runs on a section that wrote it. I measured one issue, at `sections.0.visibleOn`. The entry was therefore unreachable and is removed, with the `group` describe updated.
3. **The two entries:** stamped `'17.7.0'` (above). The D3 `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` were tested sentence by sentence against the tool, on a temp project carrying all three old keys, with the built CLI closure:
   - `os migrate meta --from 17` exits 0, replays protocol 17 → 18, applies no edit for either key, and prints the three tombstone refusals under "Migrated stack does not yet pass schema validation — 3 refusals left after the chain".
   - It also lists `ui-visibility-alias-keys-retired` among the manual changes.
   - `--write` leaves the source byte-unchanged.
4. **The suites that drove these entries live, decided per suite:**
   - `packages/spec/src/stack-conversions-record.test.ts` (found by the full spec run; not in the claim list) gets a **synthetic probe**, the F2 route. `vi.mock('./conversions/registry')` appends a test-owned live copy of the page-component rename (`stack-conversions-record-probe`, `toMajor: 15`, so every pinned `retiresIn: 16` holds). Its subject is the record, not an entry, and no later family has to re-home it.
   - `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` FIRING CONTROL 1 is **re-pointed** to `flow-node-http-callout-rename`. Its claim is specifically that a NON-retired entry still fires at the artifact door; FIRING CONTROL 2 already covers retired replay. A probe would have to mock the spec registry behind metadata-core's `@objectstack/spec` import, which is the callee under test. F5-http inherits it; with no live entry left after F5-http, that PR turns it into "the door converts at all" or retires it.
   - `packages/cli/src/commands/validate-json-strict-exit.e2e.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/stack-conversion-record-door.test.ts` are **re-pointed** to the callout rename: a flow node typed `http_request` against `http`. Both spawn the CLI over temp projects that load the built `@objectstack/spec` through a symlink, outside vitest's module graph, so no probe can reach them. This is the reason F2 gave for the `migrate meta` suites. The cells are unchanged: the converting member gives text `--strict` 1, `--json --strict` 1, `--json` 0, `warnings: []` and one notice; the canonical member gives 0 everywhere. They join the cli suites F5-http already re-homes.
   - In-file: `conversions.test.ts`'s "a live-window conversion still applies at load" is re-pointed to the callout rename, beside the two cases F5-http already owns.
5. **Readers, each fate measured:**
   - `packages/lint`: `validate-visibility-predicates.ts` (the `visibleWhen ?? visibleOn ?? visibility` limbs) and `validate-predicate-path-refs.ts` (`PREDICATE_KEYS`) now read `visibleWhen` only.
     - The doors that parse first (`os validate`, `os build`, `os verify` through `judgeAuthorTimeRules`, `defineStack`, and the metadata save door, which parses the `view` body (422, `protocol.ts:23082`) before its runtime rule pass at `:23192`) refuse either retired key by name, so a body they hand these rules cannot carry one. `os lint` hands these readers an UNPARSED stack (`cli/src/commands/lint.ts:681`-`:683`). There, a retired key's predicate is unjudged by design, pinned in `authoring-rule-input-tier.test.ts` as that door's reading beside a canonical control (review patch `860f4a18be`, after contract review FAIL `6211507698`).
     - An accepted body cannot carry either key, so keeping the limbs would be consumer-side alias tolerance.
     - `authoring-rules.ts` comments and the `rule-explanations.ts` text ("(or `visibleOn`)") are made true.
     - `page-envelope-audit.ts` is generic (any parse-consumed string re-homed into an envelope), so its code is unchanged. Its one exemplar is gone: a page still writing `visibility` now fails the parse, which the audit reports on `componentParseErrors` with the prescription. The negative control is re-pointed to that, plus a canonical control.
   - `packages/metadata-core/src/form-predicate-root-policy.ts`: `FORM_PREDICATE_KEYS` = `['visibleWhen']`. Its one caller scans `result.definition` after `applyArtifactForwardConversions`, which replays the whole chain (retired included) in every window it opens. So a legacy `visibleOn` is already renamed when it arrives; this is pinned end to end.
   - `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts`: **unchanged**. `SDUI_BASE_PROPS` is the lockstep port of objectui's own `BaseSchema` node vocabulary for the html/JSX tier, which objectui still reads (`SchemaRenderer`). It is not the spec's `PageComponentSchema`, so it moves with objectui's card.
   - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`: no read site of either key. Four comments about the view door's generic moved-key projection used the fold as their example and are made true.
6. **Examples and fixtures:** no example or app authors either key (absence walk over `packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `scripts`). Fixtures were triaged one by one:
   - **Re-spelled:** fixtures that used the alias incidentally (`editability-boundary`, the lint `groups` walk, the metadata-protocol graft test).
   - **Replaced:** pins whose subject was the deleted branch ("normalizes `visibleOn`", "still read through the alias"), each with a refusal or not-read pin plus a canonical control.
   - **Deleted:** none.
7. **objectui** (no edit there): measured at `main` `63d00da3de` and at the pinned `daeb77fc84`, identical for this question.
   - **Writers:** no designer or Studio code writes either key into saved metadata.
   - **Readers:** about 17 form-field/section renderer reads of `visibleOn`, 6 SDUI-node reads, and 3 renderer reads of page-component `visibility`. One source type coupling: `react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:191` `visibility?: PageComponent['visibility']`.
   - **Spec-shape tests that break at objectui's next spec bump:** `plugin-form/src/sectionFields.spec-parity.test.ts` reads `SpecFormFieldSchema.in.shape`, which no longer exists. `types/__tests__/flat-props-refusal-10872.test.ts` and `SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx:38` were not run.
   - **Not imported anywhere in objectui:** `normalizeVisibleWhen` and `VISIBILITY_ALIAS_KEYS`.
   - **Console Pin Gate:** it compiles objectui against objectui's installed spec (the `showStar` reading), so no break is expected there.

## Side effects of removing the pipes (measured, each pinned)

- **The dropped-refinements ledger:** 13 entries named sites through the pipe's `.in`. The build printed the corrected entries and they were applied as-is: path moves, plus one site (`api/ListInstalledPackagesResponse` … `pages.element.slots.header.options[0].type`). That site is the page `type` refinement already ledgered on the sibling responses, now reached one level shallower. The header total is 763 → 764.
- A slotted page node's `type` refusal (a non-aborting refinement) now arrives at `slots.header.type` instead of nested in an `invalid_union`; `component.test.ts` pins the new, better-located shape. An unknown key still arrives as the union.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` is regenerated by `gen:react-blocks`: `object-form` `sections` is `object[]` instead of `any[]`, because the pipe had hidden the element type. ⚠️ This is a governed path, so the PR is Tier H. The file stays at 115 → 115 lines, the published `SKILL.md` set is unchanged, and the change is generated, not hand-authored.
- Five tests read the old pipe (`.in.shape` / `def.in.shape`): `component-form-custom-fields-sections-typed.pin`, `expression-scope-data-root.pin`, `expression-scope-app-root.pin`, `component-record-related-list-parent-23134` and metadata-core's `form-predicate-root-policy`. Each is moved to `.shape`. `buildObjectFormSectionFieldEntry` (`component.zod.ts`) read the pipe at runtime and reads `.shape` now.
- Evaluated-slot population goes 34 → 31 positions; the dogfood ADR-0058 D7 ledger drops the three covers.
- `test-typecheck-debt.json`: two `TS2339 visibleOn` entries VANISHED with the deleted reads, re-recorded as the gate asked.

  - Result: 5 pins went red — `page.test.ts` ×2 (the refusal and beside-`visibleWhen`), the removal-version `JOIN` row `page-component-visibility-to-visibleWhen`, and `visibility-alias-keys-retirement.test.ts` ×2 (the `@ts-expect-error` type leg and the `defineStack` page refusal). Direction: red.
  - Restore proven: blob == HEAD `b8bce09a`, `git diff HEAD` empty. Spec tests import `src`, so there is no dist leg.

## Acceptance notes

- `normalizeVisibleWhen` and `VISIBILITY_ALIAS_KEYS` stay exported from `@objectstack/spec/shared`; no caller remains in either repo, and their docblock is made true. Retiring them is an export removal that would make the 18 D3 entry `visibility-strict-options-unexported` ("which stay exported") false, so it is left to a separate decision.
- The metadata save door's canonicalization policy for retired spellings is untouched (the seat's separate decision). For `view` and `page` the door parses the body as stored, so the old keys meet the refusal there (422).
- `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS`, every other conversion entry and objectui are untouched.
- Labels: the write budget names only `skip-changeset`, and only when nothing publishes. This PR publishes, so it carries no label from me.
